description:
Connect an automatic publication destination only after explicit user confirmation (confirmed=true).
request sends a channel/group chooser to the token owner's personal Telegram chat;
after selection, retrieve channel_id with list_publication_channels.
existing accepts an @username or link when the bot is already an administrator; returns channel_id.
Owner and bot permissions, anonymous administrator restrictions and destination limits match the bot.
name: connect_publication_channel
title: Connect Publication Channel
